blocks.text: DNA ki banawat ki daryaft (1953) aur central dogma ke khayal (1957) ke baad yeh ahem sawalat saamne aaye:

items: DNA, jis mein sirf chaar qisam ke nucleotides hain, hazaron khaas proteins banane ki genetic maloomat kaise rakh sakta hai?
Agar DNA mein maloomat genetic code ki shakal mein hai, to is code ki noeiyat (nature) kya hai?
Agar genetic code DNA mein nucleotides ki tarteeb (order) ki shakal mein hai, to yeh polypeptide mein amino acids ki tarteeb kaise tay karta hai?

blocks.text: In sawalon ne biologists mein aik dor (race) shuru kar di. Is silsile mein bari kamyabiyan yeh theen:

1961 mein Francis Crick aur us ke saathiyon ne yeh khayal pesh kiya: “genetic code maloomat ke tukron (blocks) ka silsila hai jinhein codons kehte hain. Har codon banne wale polypeptide ka aik amino acid tay karta hai”. Unhon ne mazeed socha ke:

items: agar aik nucleotide aik amino acid tay kare to sirf chaar amino acids ka code ban sakta hai;
do nucleotides ka sequence bhi sirf 16 (4 × 4) codons banata, yaani sirf 16 amino acids.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Proteins banane ke liye DNA mein maujood maloomat ko genetic code kehte hain. Genetic code 3 nucleotides wale codons ka silsila hai.

Is liye woh is nateeje par pohanche ke aik codon 3 nucleotides ka sequence hona chahiye, aur yeh 3-nucleotide sequence aik khaas amino acid tay karta hai. 4 nucleotides ko 64 (4 × 4 × 4) mukhtalif tareeqon se joda ja sakta hai, jo 20 amino acids ke code ke liye kaafi se bhi zyada hain.

Crick ke nataij ke mutabiq genetic code teen nucleotides ke musalsal sequences ka bana hai, yaani yeh triplet code hai. Jab gene kaam karta hai to DNA ke codons mRNA ke complementary (jor wale) codons ki shakal mein transcribe hote hain. Maslan DNA ka codon TAC mRNA mein AUG ban jata hai. Aam taur par “codon” se murad mRNA ka codon hota hai, lekin kabhi kabhi, khaas kar DNA ki mutations ki baat karte hue, DNA ke codons ko bhi "codon" keh dete hain.
Marshall Nirenberg, Philip Leder aur Har Gobind Khorana ka kaam

1961 mein American biochemist Marshall Nirenberg ne poly-U mRNA banaya, yaani aisa mRNA jis mein sirf uracil nucleotides the. Us ne yeh mRNA bacteria ke cytoplasm mein daala to bacteria ne aisa polypeptide banaya jis mein bohat se phenylalanine amino acids the. Us ne nateeja nikala ke codon UUU phenylalanine ka code hai. Nirenberg aur aik aur American geneticist Philip Leder ne saare triplet codons test kiye aur 47 codons ke amino acids maloom kiye. Har Gobind Khorana (jinhon ne Government College, Lahore se taleem mukammal ki) ne baqi 17 triplet codons ke amino acids maloom kiye.

Kul 64 codons mein se teen codons (UGA, UAG aur UAA) stop codons ya nonsense codons hain. Agar in mein se koi mRNA ke aakhir mein ho to woh koi amino acid tay nahin karta aur protein banna rok deta hai. Codon AUG start codon ka kaam karta hai; yeh har genetic code ke shuru mein hota hai aur amino acid methionine tay karta hai.

1968 ka Physiology & Medicine ka Nobel Prize Nirenberg (genetic code par kaam), Har Gobind Khorana (nucleic acids banana) aur Robert Holley (transfer-RNA ki kimiyai banawat daryaft karna) ko diya gaya.

blocks.prompt: Agar DNA (template strand) ka triplet AAA ho to mRNA codon kya hoga aur woh kaun sa amino acid tay karega?
blocks.explanation: mRNA codon UUU hoga (A ke saamne U), jo phenylalanine ka code hai; yahi Nirenberg ke poly-U tajarbe ka nateeja tha.

items: Crick (1961): codon 3 nucleotides ka; 4 × 4 × 4 = 64 codons, 20 amino acids ke liye kaafi.
Nirenberg: UUU = phenylalanine; Nirenberg aur Leder ne 47 codons, Khorana ne baqi 17 maloom kiye.
AUG start codon (methionine); UAA, UAG, UGA stop codons.
